summary: Iteration 7 backend + frontend validation. All 5 pytest cases pass (5/5). Frontend: /checkin already-ingresado flow renders red card with title 'Esta orden ya fue ingresada', plate/código/cliente, status 'Aprobada (lista para Revisión 360°)' and data-testid='search-another-btn' that correctly dismisses the card. /service-orders kanban now shows all 8 expected columns (Agendado, Ingresado, En Revisión, En Corte, Asignado, En Proceso, Servicio Completado, Facturado y Entregado). The cutting gate works end-to-end: assignment blocked when polarizado/PPF order has cutting_status != 'completado' and succeeds after cutting completion.

CheckIn.jsx imports generateOrderPDF and invokes it inside handleApprove (lines 18 + 332) — PDF auto-download wired (browser download not asserted per request)
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/cutting/{order_id}/complete (server.py L1863) does not validate that order.status is currently 'en_corte'. Calling it on a fresh order would silently set cutting_status='completado' without ever moving through 'en_corte', allowing the assignment gate to be bypassed. Recommend adding `if order.get('status') != 'en_corte': raise HTTPException(400, …)`.

PUT /api/cutting/{order_id}/complete also does not write to order_history with proper status transition (it only logs action='cutting_completed' but leaves order.status as 'en_corte' instead of moving back to 'en_revision' for assignment or to a 'corte_completado' state). Confirm this matches the intended flow with main agent.
POST /api/orders/assign cutting_keywords list duplicates the catalog in get_cutting_pending. Extract to a shared module-level constant to keep the two paths in sync.
server.py is now 1921 lines — strong candidate for splitting into routers (orders, cutting, inspections, payments, settings) per code-review guideline (>700 lines).
